title: 한국해양소년단연맹 육성에 관한 법률 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Loans of State and Public Property and Support for Facilities, etc.)
(1) Where necessary to foster the Association, the State or a local government may, notwithstanding the State Property Act, the Public Property and Commodity Management Act, or other applicable provisions, lend or transfer State or public property, school facilities, and military facilities to the Association free of charge, or allow the Association to use them and obtain profits therefrom, to the extent that such use does not interfere with their intended purposes.
(2) Where property or facilities are lent or transferred free of charge or their use and enjoyment is permitted under paragraph (1), the details and conditions shall be as prescribed by a contract between the administrative agency responsible for managing the relevant property or facility and the Association.
